title: [3.4] Changing loop status from AAPS client does not work
symptom: Changing loop status from AAPS client never does anything on main AAPS. In NsClientv3 tab on main AAPS, the Create Treatment with mode= DISABLED_LOOP is seen but nothing else seems to happen.
cause: A new setting in NSClient settings needs to be enabled to allow changing loop status from AAPS client.
fix: Enable the new setting in NSClient settings. The setting is not named explicitly in the thread, but it is documented in the release notes.
evidence_quote: There is a new setting in NSClient settings which you need to enable.
